edition_policy: Frozen original English editions. Not a continuously updated legal register; changes require a new packet version. Exhaustive subsequent-amendment/corrigendum certification is not claimed.

extraction.method: verify.py selected_text: complete official XHTML elements/sibling ranges; pypdf 6.21.4 default extraction for the ESMA two-page PDF
extraction.normalization: Whitespace-only normalization within lines; HTML table cells joined with | and structural blocks separated by newlines. No paraphrase, OCR, truncation, or hyphen repair.
extraction.authority: Original documents control over normalized extracts. Full originals preserve all footnotes and cross-referenced material.
extraction.pdf_note: Register PDF has rotated tables. Its authoritative structured XHTML is used for all extracts; layout-mode PDF extraction was not accepted as complete.
